user.title: Ebara Hydrostation
user.description: Searching for Ebara Hydrostation gateways on the network...

gateway.title: Select Gateway
gateway.description: Choose the ESP32 gateway to use:

manual_gateway.title: Gateway Address
manual_gateway.description: Enter the IP address of the ESP32 gateway. It must already be set up in the ESPHome integration.

select_hydro.title: Select Hydrostation
select_hydro.description: Choose the Hydrostation to add. If the list is empty, check the pump and submit again to retry.

error.no_devices_found: No supported Hydrostation discovered. Make sure the pump is powered on and within Bluetooth range of the gateway, then submit again.
error.esphome_entry_missing: No ESPHome device with this address. Add the gateway to the ESPHome integration first.

abort.gateway_already_configured: This gateway is already used by another Hydrostation (one gateway drives one pump).

gateway_not_connected.message: The ESP32 gateway is not connected.

gateway_entity_missing.message: The ESP32 gateway does not expose the entity '{entity}': update the gateway firmware.

gateway_outdated.title: Ebara gateway needs updating
gateway_outdated.description: The ESP32 gateway {gateway} does not expose these entities: {missing}. Update the ESPHome component (recompile the gateway) and add the new entities to its YAML as described in the changelog. Until then the corresponding Hydrostation entities stay unknown.
